Key Genes Investigated

  • EPAS1 / EGLN1: Key hypoxia pathway genes strongly associated with high-altitude adaptation in Tibetan populations.

  • SLC24A5 / OCA2 / TYR: Genes driving lighter skin and eye pigmentation, typically selected in higher latitudes (e.g., Europeans).

  • EDAR: The V370A variant is associated with increased sweat gland density and thicker hair in East Asians.

  • LCT (MCM6): The 13910*T variant is the primary driver of lactase persistence in European populations.

  • ALDH2 / ADH1B: Variants conferring the 'alcohol flush' reaction, heavily selected in East Asian populations.

  • TRPM8: A cold-sensing receptor variant implicated in cold adaptation and migraine susceptibility.

  • FADS1: Fatty acid desaturase genes adapted to agricultural diets (plant-rich vs meat-rich).

  • ABCC11: The variant responsible for dry earwax and reduced apocrine gland secretion, common in East Asia.
